before: The private adapter could plan cell content but did not plan native row insertion/deletion with inherited properties and plain cell values.
after: A pure planner validates canonical row ownership, native geometry, locks, and reference cells through an immutable native preview. It returns native table intents with original anchors and no preview IDs.
reason: The planner applies no live edits and adds no shared format. It reuses existing table operations. The native tracked-row fix has its own compatibility decision. Rich inserted fragments and explicit properties remain a required prerequisite for complete target planning and row review.
